results.content:
## Frequently asked questions

### Is Bookella free?

Yes. The free version holds 50 books and 3 collections, and the timer, reading sessions, goals, notes, loans and scanning have no limits. There are no ads in the app. Premium removes the limits on books and collections and adds detailed statistics, photos in notes, text recognition from photos, PDF export of notes and AI book picks. Text recognition and AI picks can be tried for free first. Premium comes as a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. If a subscription ends, nothing you created is locked.

### Which devices does it run on?

iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets. One account keeps your library in sync on all of them.

### Can I import my books from Goodreads or another app? [...] ### Is my library private?

Your library, notes and ratings are visible only to you. You decide what to share: a link to a book or a collection, or a note as a card image. You can delete your account with all its data from the app at any time — the deletion page explains exactly what goes and when.

### Does it work without a connection?

Yes. The library lives on the device, so you can add books, log a session or write a quote on a plane, and it syncs when the network comes back. [...] ## What can you do with Bookella?

### All your books in one place

Paper books, e-books and audiobooks, read and unread. Your library is right there, cover by cover.

### See how far you’ve read

Every book shows your progress and how long it’ll take to finish at your pace.

### Time your reading

Start the timer when you open a book and watch your daily goal fill up. No timer? Just log the page you stopped on.

## Why Bookella?

### Goals that keep you reading

Set a goal for the year and one for each day. A little reading every day adds up fast.

### Add books in seconds

Pick from reading lists, scan a barcode, or bring your library over from Goodreads, StoryGraph and other apps.

## Do NOT waste your money on Bookstera

Do NOT waste your money on Bookstera. It’s advertised as an easy way to create books, but you’re limited to just 3 credits, and the results are a complete mess – formatting errors everywhere, poor AI generation, and no real editing tools. I spent hours doing over 1000 manual corrections that the app should have handled. This feels like a total scam. The app is worthless and frustrating. I’ve already disputed the charge with my bank. Avoid at all costs!

I don’t like this. You get constant ads to upgrade and pay more before it even delivers the first round of books. Daily reminders to upgrade before you’ve even started, even emails under time pressure with “exploding offers” that expire in 3-2-1… before you’ve checked out. Feels scammy and not transparent (you pay for x then instantly get a message to pay more for y, always seems like you’ve “just paid again” but still didn’t get the full package that you need. Hard to get started actually using the product but their immediate link to the payment options works perfectly- unsurprisingly…No recommendation from my side.
